description_en: Creates or edits a custom namespace
description_zh: 调用InsertOrUpdateRegion接口创建或编辑自定义命名空间
kebab_example: aliyun edas insert-or-update-region --region-tag cn-beijing:test --region-name test_region --region cn-hangzhou
name: InsertOrUpdateRegion

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the namespace.

The ID of a custom namespace is in the `Region ID:Namespace identifier` format. Example: cn-beijing:tdy218.

The ID of the default namespace is in the `region ID` format. Example: cn-beijing
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间ID：
自定义命名空间ID格式为：`地域ID:命名空间标示符`，例如：cn-beijing:tdy218。
默认命名空间ID格式为：`地域ID`，例如：cn-beijing
parameters.name: region_tag

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace. The name can be up to 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间名称，长度不超过63个字符
parameters.name: region_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the namespace. The description can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间描述，长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create or modify the namespace. If this parameter is left empty or is set to 0, the namespace is created. Otherwise, the namespace is modified
parameters.help_zh: 参数为空或ID为0时表示创建命名空间，其他情况表示编辑
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable remote debugging. Valid values:

true: enables remote debugging.

false: disables remote debugging
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许进行远程调试：
true：允许。
false：不允许
parameters.name: debug_enable

parameters.help_en:
The type of the registry.

default: the shared registry of Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)

exclusive_mse: a Microservices Engine (MSE) registry
parameters.help_zh:
注册中心类型：
default：EDAS共享注册中心。
exclusive_mse：MSE Nacos注册中心
parameters.name: registry_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MSE registry
parameters.name: mse_instance_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned

UserDefineRegionEntity.description_en: The information about the custom namespace

BelongRegion.description_en: The ID of the region to which the namespace belongs

DebugEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether remote debugging is enabled. Valid values:

true: Remote debugging is enabled.

false: Remote debugging is disabled
DebugEnable.description_zh:
是否允许进行远程调试：
true：允许。
false：不允许

Id.description_en: Indicates whether the namespace is created or modified. If this parameter is left empty or 0 is returned, the namespace is created. Otherwise, the namespace is modified
Id.description_zh: 参数为空或ID为0时表示创建命名空间，其他情况表示编辑

RegionId.description_en:
The ID of the namespace.

The ID of a custom namespace is in the `region ID:namespace identifier` format. Example: cn-beijing:tdy218.

The ID of the default namespace is in the `region ID` format. Example: cn-beijing
RegionId.description_zh:
命名空间ID：
自定义命名空间ID格式为：`地域ID:命名空间标示符`，例如：cn-beijing:tdy218。
默认命名空间ID格式为：`地域ID`，例如：cn-beijing

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the custom namespace belongs
